label: Effective delivery through an interrupted borrower-only order and q44 source supply
summary: Compared the q44 distinct actual OwnBeing cause with a strengthened infinite borrower-only account in docs/notes/q44-inferential-dependency.md#can-effective-local-supply-continue-throughout-a-borrower-only-order. The earlier guarded state-indexed tail leaves multiple populated suffixes possible. Strengthening its law to effective delivery at an intact link gives an exact arbitrary-interruption criterion. Population is possible iff some upstream suffix is intact. In any populated solution, x is active iff every link at or above x is intact. Each such x has an actual distinct neighbour under the existing tailAtState profile. All surviving local responses are compatible with the explicit interpretation OwnBeing nowhere, so the q44 conclusion is not forced by selection and transmission. Unbounded interruptions eliminate the populated solution, whereas a separately posited active input can sustain an isolated lower segment. The difference is independence of that channel, not existential independence. Proof and exact reproduction command are linked in the note (Scratch/q44-borrowed-supply/InterruptedTransmission.lean, local Lean check, unregistered). This is an analyst's structural intervention model, not a counterexample to real productive existential borrowing or a defeat of supplier completeness. The cut-surviving input could borrow its actuality elsewhere. The conditional case for a nonborrowed giver rests on the received-as-produced demand for an account of the order’s productive exercise and on the proposal that an intrinsically actual giver exercises its power toward these recipients. The primitive populated-order rival explains its member responses and survives. Existing q44 composition, reception, ancestry and source-selection obligations remain. That single-chain investigation added no registered entailment, source attribution or formal premise change. Follow-up on 20babef7: the finite supplier-audit model proves that every finite selection of complete incoming lists with the endless record permits both root verdicts, even for a chosen predecessor cone. A finite closed roster with strict rank in every compatible assignment suffices for de dicto knowledge. See docs/notes/de-ente-esse-source-1628.md#supplier-completeness-under-extension-of-an-audited-order for the de re boundary and the remaining actual-esse applicability question. The registered parallel-chain classification subsumes the single-chain transmission lemmas. One on/off choice per chain with an intact tail describes every solution. The diagonal argument shows why a countable catalogue cannot cover every allowed assignment on countably many independent intact chains. See docs/notes/causal-finitism-367.md#how-many-choices-does-a-chain-of-borrowers-require.
blocker: Investigate what grounds the actual exercise in a particular supplier-complete esse cone at matching scope: a giver whose intrinsic actuality suffices for giving to this recipient, or a concrete governing whole that realizes its members' exercise. An active input that survives a channel cut is only relatively independent. Local interventions do not establish collective rootedness, OwnBeing, common selection or that the existential relation has this transmission semantics.

current_assessment.scope: How many independent activity choices does an infinite chain of borrowers need under the same local transmission rule?
current_assessment.assessment: One intact infinite chain has exactly two states. The state of one receiver fixes the state of every bearer on that chain. Observing activity fixes the choice on that chain alone. Each other uncoupled chain with an intact upstream tail adds one independent choice. Even with countably many chains the uniform active state has a short description, although any countable catalogue misses some admissible assignment. A finite ontology can have a headcount advantage at matched adequacy. Explaining this receiver’s actual power requires an account of why the selected state obtains, whether through a concrete law or whole whose obtaining accounts for that activity, or a source that actually supplies it.
current_assessment.next_test: Fix this receiver and the particular power exercised. Test whether it continues exercising that same power after a verified cut blocks every relay input for it, and whether a separately identified feed delivers that power to this receiver. A feed independent of the interrupted channel could itself borrow power elsewhere.
current_assessment.evidence: The registered classification and its diagonal consequence extend the existing one-chain intervention proof. The earlier finite-grounding and parsimony judgments retain their own scopes.
current_assessment.supersedes: None. Applies the earlier one-chain result to parsimony across disjoint chains.
